question:
Which of the following pair of plastids - thing stored is NOT correct?

I. Amyloplasts - oils and fats

II. Aleuroplasts - carbohydrates
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II.**__

__
 
• **Both pair is not correct.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amyloplasts:**

 
 
• ​**Amyloplasts** are **plastids **that make and **store starch** in internal membrane spaces.
 
• **Amyloplasts store carbohydrates (starch), e.g., potatoes. Hence pair I is not correct.**
 
• Inside amyloplasts, starch forms **insoluble particles** referred to as** starch grains.**
 
• They are frequently discovered in the **tissues of vegetative plants**, such as **tubers (potatoes) and bulbs.**
 
• Amyloplasts are also hypothesized to play a role in **plant root growth **in a** downward direction **and **gravity sensing (gravitropism).**
 
 
 
• **Aleuroplasts:**
 
 
• A **leucoplast kind of plastid** called an aleuroplast is used to** store proteins. **Hence pair II is not correct.
 
• They are commonly **found in seeds.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Elaioplasts:**

 
 
• The **fats and oils** that the plant needs are stored by **elaioplasts.**
 
• **Monocotyledon plant seeds** and **liverworts **both contain it.
 
 
 
• **Chromoplast:**
 
 
• Chromoplasts are **carotenoid-accumulating plastids.**
 
• They give various** tubers and roots**, along with a variety of** flowers and fruits, their color. **
